citation.verbatim: The tender offer expired at 11:59 p.m., New York City time, on June 5, 2024. A total of 119,018,767 shares of Monster's common stock were validly tendered and not validly withdrawn at the final purchase price of $53.00 per share or as purchase price tenders... Monster accepted for purchase a total of 56,603,773 shares... at the final purchase price of $53.00 per share, for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $3.0 billion... shares were accepted for purchase on a pro rata basis, except for tenders of "odd lots," which will be accepted in full. Monster has been informed by the depositary that the final proration factor for the tender offer is approximately 47.18%.
